production.note: US model years 1990-1995. Chevrolet: "Total production of the 1990-95 ZR-1 was 6,939" and "the ZR-1's 1995 final year".

body.note: CorvSport's ZR-1 entry: 'LT5 5.7 OHV 350 V-8. Multi-Port Fuel Injection (COUPE)'; the ZR-1 was not offered as a convertible.

configuration.note: Chevrolet: 'The all-aluminum LT5 engine ... sharing only a 5.7-liter displacement with other small-block engines'.

displacementL.note: 5,727 cc: '349 cu in, 5727 cc' (Corvette Action Center LT5 specifications). Vette Vues: '349 in3, 5727 cm3' (vettevues-1990-specs).

aspiration.note: Inferred: LT5 DOHC V8, no forced induction.

transmission.note: Vette Vues' 1990 ZR-1 specifications: '6-speed Manual Transmission'. The ZR-1 was manual only (CorvSport's '4 Speed Auto Transmission (Standard)' line applies to the base car).

powerHp.note: Quote (Chevrolet ZR1 history release, reproduced by Corvette Action Center): "the ZR-1's 375-horespower (280 kW) LT5 V-8 engine"; "a horsepower increase to 405 (302 kW) in 1993". Corvette Action Center's LT5 specifications: 1990-1992 "375 hp @ 6,000 rpm", 1993-1995 "405 hp @ 5,800 rpm" (cac-lt5-engine-specs). Reference year 1990: each rating covers three of the six model years, so the launch year is used.

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL (enthusiast sites and a database). 1990 ZR-1 coupe, 6-speed manual (the only transmission). Quote (CorvSport, Cameron Martel, 1990 Corvette specifications): ZR-1 row "Curb Weight – Manual (LBS)": "3,465"; base coupe (manual) "3,330" lbs. Vette Vues (unsigned, 1990 ZR1 specifications): "Curb weight: 3,465 lbs" (vettevues-1990-specs). Edmunds 1990 ZR1 2dr Coupe: "Curb weight | 3,465 lbs." (edmunds-corvette-zr1-1990). The Vette Registry's 3,330 lb (vetteregistry-1990-zr1) is the base L98 coupe's figure (Corvette Action Center 1990 specifications: row "Curb Weight": "3330 (6-speed) 3284 (Auto.)" for the L98 coupe, cac-1990-specs); see discrepancies.

sources.publisher: Chevrolet (release reproduced by Corvette Action Center)
sources.title: Corvette ZR1: It's Good to Be the King

discrepancies.reason: The Vette Registry's ZR1 page gives 3,330 lb, which is the 1990 base (L98) coupe with the 6-speed: CorvSport gives 3,330 lb for the base manual coupe and 3,465 lb for the ZR-1, and Corvette Action Center's 1990 table gives 3,330 lb for the L98 coupe (6-speed).
discrepancies.resolution: The 3,330 lb figure belongs to a different car (the base coupe), so the ZR-1 figure of 3,465 lb (CorvSport, Vette Vues, Edmunds) is used.

discrepancies.reason: Vette Vues and Edmunds print 380 hp @ 6,200 rpm; Chevrolet's release and its LT5 specifications give 375 hp for 1990-1992.

provisionalNote: Weight (3,465 lb) rests on CorvSport and Vette Vues (enthusiast sites) and Edmunds (database), which agree; the Vette Registry's 3,330 lb is the base coupe's figure. A GM/Chevrolet 1990 ZR-1 press kit or specification sheet, or a major magazine's specification panel for the 1990 ZR-1, would replace it.
